On 01/09/2015 12:57 AM, Peky wrote:
> Hy!
>
> I´m using your "Political Democracy" example in my seminar work to show
> the application of SEM in R. I´m also supposed to know which quality
> kriteria does sem() funcion optimize and which Algorithmus is for that
> purpose applyed.

When estimator = "ML", the objective function minimized by sem() is
based on eq 96 in the Mplus technical appendices:

http://www.statmodel.com/download/techappen.pdf

The algorithm used to minimize this objective function is a quasi-newton
method as implemented in the nlminb() function. See ?nlminb for more
details.

For a very detailed discussion of the code underlying the nlminb
optimizer, see:

http://netlib.bell-labs.com/cm/cs/cstr/153.pdf

Yves.
